goal: Let RPC and REST users directly inspect decoded redeem and witness scripts in transaction inputs
Eliminates the need to manually extract raw bytes and run separate script decoding calls
agreement: Substantive concept approval with detailed implementation review (sedited)
Prior objections on script detection and naming were resolved (luke-jr, naiyoma, sedited)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it resolves a long-standing usability gap for tools inspecting detailed transaction inputs
Saves external tooling from parsing raw byte pushes to interpret P2SH and SegWit scripts
